game_concept: A card battler set in Frost Peaks – Crevasse Bridge, a rope bridge over a crevasse: the ice axe ranger must handle falling rocks while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Cipher Decoder: Shift characters using ord/chr operations to decode secret notes.
theme: Frost Peaks – Crevasse Bridge: a rope bridge over a crevasse
core_gameplay_loop: In Crevasse Bridge, repeat each round: Shift characters using ord/chr operations to decode secret notes. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the decoded value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 9 consecutive correct decisions about decoded to power up the ice axe ranger and open the rope bridge.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 4 (applied tier): Cipher Decoder
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Cipher Decoder' (Week 8 slot 15), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Crevasse Bridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how decoded changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against falling rocks in Crevasse Bridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 9.
